The SDK leverages Node.js's `zlib` bindings, which adhere to the original zlib specification and perform synchronized flushing of decompressed streams at block boundaries. This could also be the cause of some connection flakiness!
statement: Miniz seems to handle SYNC‑boundary flushing differently than zlib, which leads to data stalling.
